# uptimekuma_monitor_ntp (Data Source)

Get NTP (Network Time Protocol) monitor information by ID or name

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an NTP monitor by name
data "uptimekuma_monitor_ntp" "pool" {
  name = "NTP Pool"
}

# Look up an NTP monitor by ID
data "uptimekuma_monitor_ntp" "by_id" {
  id = 42
}

# Use the data source to reference an existing monitor
output "ntp_hostname" {
  value = data.uptimekuma_monitor_ntp.pool.hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier
- `name` (String) Monitor name

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) NTP server IP address or hostname
- `ntp_root_dispersion_threshold` (Number) Root dispersion in milliseconds at which the monitor is considered down. Null while the check falls back to 500.
- `ntp_stratum_threshold` (Number) Stratum at which the monitor is considered down. Null while the check falls back to 5.
- `ntp_time_offset_threshold` (Number) Absolute time offset in milliseconds at which the monitor is considered down. Null while the check falls back to 1000.
- `port` (Number) UDP port of the NTP server. Null while the check falls back to 123.
- `timeout` (Number) Query timeout in seconds
